Here is the translation of the given Coptic text into English:

**"The good name endures with justice and righteousness. God has established knowledge and synesis (understanding/wisdom) in the treasury of His good counsel, so that they may be in the hearts of those who love Him."**

### Breakdown:
- **Ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲥⲉⲙⲓⲥⲓ** – "The good name"
- **ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉⲧϣⲱϣ ⲉ̀ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥⲩⲛⲏ** – "endures with justice and righteousness"
- **Ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲥⲉⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ** – "God has established"
- **ⲅⲛⲱⲙⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲩⲛⲏⲇⲏⲥⲓⲥ** – "knowledge and understanding/wisdom"
- **ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲑⲣⲉⲩⲁⲣϣⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ** – "in the treasury of His good counsel"
- **ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ** – "so that they may be in the hearts of those who love Him"

This passage carries a theological and moral message, emphasizing divine wisdom and righteousness.
